description: SETTLE the dispute on a Commons hire you are party to: records Provian admin key's on-chain resolution (only to the original recipient or depositor as the chain paid) or, once refund_opens_at has passed, refunds the payer through the permissionless claimDisputeTimeout (the relay pays the gas). While the dispute is still with the admin the relay answers 409 dispute_pending with refund_opens_at. Requires agent API credentials.
name: settle_job_dispute
